products.title: NatureMist Amla Powder
products.descriptionHtml:
Bring Amla into the part of your routine that needs a little time and care. This fruit powder is a versatile ingredient for conditioning hair masks and simple rinse-off face masks.

For hair, use it in a pre-wash routine for a softer feel and natural-looking shine. For skin, keep the preparation simple, apply without scrubbing and follow the skin-use directions on the pack. Introduce one botanical at a time.

Amla has a place in Ayurvedic tradition. Ingredient research does not establish clinical results for this powder; this is cosmetic care, not a treatment for hair loss or skin conditions.

Best suited to

  • Conditioning hair masks
  • Rinse-off skin-mask routines
  • People who prefer mixing a fresh botanical paste

How to use

  1. Preparation: Read the pack directions and test a small area before first use. Mix the required powder with clean water in a clean bowl.
  2. Hair: Apply the smooth paste through hair in sections. Follow the hair-use timing on the pack, then rinse thoroughly.
  3. Skin: Apply a thin, smooth layer to intact skin, avoiding eyes and lips. Follow the skin-use timing on the pack; rinse gently without scrubbing and follow with moisturiser.
  4. After use: Prepare only what you need and discard leftover wet paste.

Use with care

  • For external use only. Test on a small area before first use and stop if irritation occurs.
  • Avoid eyes, lips, broken or irritated skin and breathing in loose powder.
  • Strand-test light, grey, bleached, porous or colour-treated hair.
  • Use the directions for the area being treated; hair application times do not apply to facial skin.

products.title: NatureMist Reetha Powder
products.descriptionHtml:
Reetha, also known as soapnut, contains naturally occurring saponins that give it a cleansing role. Use this fruit-shell powder in a rinse-off wash-day routine to help remove excess oil and everyday buildup.

The amount of foam and the feel of a botanical wash differ from a formulated shampoo. Mix with water as directed, handle gently and rinse thoroughly while protecting your eyes.

This product belongs in a hair-cleansing routine. It is not recommended as a face mask and is not a treatment for acne, dandruff or scalp disease.

Best suited to

  • Rinse-off hair cleansing
  • Wash-day routines
  • People familiar with botanical hair washes

How to use

  1. Preparation: Test on a small area and follow the pack quantities. Mix with clean water into the consistency directed on the label.
  2. Hair: Work gently through wet roots and lengths, keeping the mixture away from your face and eyes.
  3. Rinse: Rinse thoroughly without leaving the mixture on longer than the pack directs. Follow with your usual conditioner if needed.
  4. After use: Discard leftover wet mixture and keep the dry powder container sealed.

Use with care

  • For external use only. Test on a small area before use.
  • Keep away from the face and eyes; saponins can sting. Rinse with plenty of water if contact occurs.
  • Do not apply to broken or irritated skin. Stop use if irritation occurs.
  • Avoid breathing in loose powder. This is not a facial mask.

products.title: NatureMist Indigo Powder
products.descriptionHtml:
Indigo leaf powder is selected for one clear purpose: plant-based hair colour. It is commonly used in a planned henna-and-indigo routine to develop darker-looking shades.

The result depends on your starting colour, porosity, previous treatments and preparation. Indigo alone can appear blue or green on light or grey hair; it does not reliably turn grey hair black by itself.

Follow the full pack instructions, carry out the directed skin test before every use and test a strand before colouring all your hair. Indigo is for scalp hair only, not skin-care masks, eyebrows or eyelashes.

Best suited to

  • Scalp-hair colouring routines
  • People familiar with henna-and-indigo preparation
  • Users willing to skin-test and strand-test before colouring

How to use

  1. Before colouring: Read the full pack directions and carry out the directed skin test before every use. Test a strand to check shade and hair feel.
  2. Preparation: Plan any separate henna step first. Wear gloves and protect clothing and surfaces. Mix with water exactly as directed.
  3. Hair colour: Apply and rinse using the mixing and processing times on the pack. Do not extend the time or add unlisted ingredients.
  4. After use: Rinse thoroughly, clean splashes and discard leftover mixed paste.

Use with care

  • For external use on scalp hair only. Do not use for skin masks, eyebrows or eyelashes.
  • Carry out the directed skin test before every use; a clear test does not guarantee that a reaction cannot occur.
  • Indigo alone may appear blue or green on light or grey hair. Strand-test before full application.
  • Wear gloves. Avoid eyes, damaged or irritated scalp, inhalation of powder and contact with fabrics.
  • Stop and rinse if irritation occurs. Do not use if you have reacted to this product before.

products.title: NatureMist Bhringraj Powder
products.descriptionHtml:
Bhringraj has a long association with Ayurvedic hair-care traditions. This botanical powder is intended for a rinse-off hair and scalp mask, prepared fresh with water.

Apply gently in sections, follow the timing on the pack and rinse or cleanse out thoroughly. It can be used on its own or included in a hair-mask routine after each ingredient has been tried separately.

We position Bhringraj for cosmetic hair care, not as a hair-growth treatment or a way to reverse greying. Published extract studies do not establish those results for this powder.

Best suited to

  • Traditional hair and scalp rituals
  • Rinse-off hair masks
  • People building a botanical wash-day routine

How to use

  1. Preparation: Test on a small area and mix with clean water using the pack directions.
  2. Hair: Apply the smooth paste gently to scalp and hair in sections, avoiding irritated areas.
  3. Rinse: Follow the pack timing, then rinse or cleanse thoroughly. Use your normal conditioner if needed.
  4. After use: Discard leftover wet paste and keep the dry powder sealed.

Use with care

  • For external use only. Test on a small area and stop use if irritation occurs.
  • Avoid eyes, broken or irritated skin and breathing in loose powder.
  • Strand-test light, grey, bleached or porous hair.
  • This cosmetic powder is not a treatment for hair loss or scalp conditions.

products.title: NatureMist Hibiscus Powder
products.descriptionHtml:
Bring a floral touch to your hair and skin routine. Hibiscus flower powder is a cosmetic conditioning ingredient that can be prepared fresh for a hair mask or a rinse-off skin mask.

For hair, work through the lengths as directed for a softness-focused ritual. For skin, start with a simple water-based preparation, apply without scrubbing and rinse gently according to the skin-use directions on the pack.

Natural colour can mark fabrics and may affect very light or porous hair, so protect surfaces and strand-test first. This is cosmetic care; it is not a treatment for acne, pigmentation or hair loss.

Best suited to

  • Softness-focused hair masks
  • Rinse-off skin-conditioning rituals
  • People who prefer a fresh-mixed floral powder

How to use

  1. Preparation: Test on a small area and mix a fresh smooth paste with clean water, following the pack quantities.
  2. Hair: Spread through the lengths as directed. Follow the hair-use timing on the pack, then rinse thoroughly.
  3. Skin: Apply a thin layer to intact skin, avoiding eyes and lips. Follow the skin-use timing on the pack; rinse gently without scrubbing and follow with moisturiser.
  4. After use: Discard leftover wet paste and clean the bowl and any marked surfaces.

Use with care

  • For external use only. Test on a small area first and stop use if irritation occurs.
  • Natural pigment can mark skin, clothing and surfaces; protect fabrics and rinse well.
  • Strand-test very light, grey, bleached, porous or colour-treated hair.
  • Avoid eyes, lips, broken or irritated skin and breathing in loose powder.
  • Use the separate skin directions for a face mask; do not use hair-mask timing on the face.

products.title: NatureMist Shikakai Powder
products.descriptionHtml:
Make room for a familiar botanical wash-day ingredient. Shikakai fruit powder contains naturally occurring saponins and is traditionally used in hair-cleansing routines.

Mix a fresh preparation with water, work through wet hair without rough rubbing and rinse thoroughly. A botanical wash feels different from a formulated shampoo; use your usual conditioner afterwards when needed.

Shikakai is selected here for hair care. We do not recommend this powder as a facial mask or claim that it treats dandruff, hair loss or skin conditions.

  • People exploring traditional wash-day ingredients
  • Rinse-off cleansing followed by conditioner

How to use

  1. Preparation: Test on a small area. Mix with clean water using the quantity and consistency on the pack.
  2. Hair: Work gently through wet roots and lengths without rough rubbing, avoiding your face and eyes.
  3. Rinse: Follow the pack timing, rinse thoroughly and use your usual conditioner if needed.
  4. After use: Prepare fresh each time and discard leftover wet paste.

Use with care

  • For external use only. Test on a small area before use.
  • Avoid eyes, lips, broken or irritated skin and breathing in loose powder.
  • Stop use if irritation occurs. This product is intended for hair cleansing, not facial masks.
